_about: 0131 (docs/SHIPS_AND_SKILLS.md §5.2, step S9): the skill catalogue — groups, and every skill's group, rank, where it is enrolled (none = counts as enrolled; academy = any academy; line_yard = any build yard of its line's countries) and prerequisites (all rows with choice 0 are needed; rows sharing a choice > 0 need ANY ONE). The four live skills (live: true) keep their 0016 rows; only their profile is authored here. Applied by migration 0131; scripts/db/world-guard.mjs holds public.skills / skill_profile / skill_prereqs to this file. K1 (docs/SKILLS_AND_CAPTAINS.md §3.2-3.3, D2-D5): anywhere = any port (the general skills, EVE's Skills on Demand); line_yard is unchanged.
_effects: 0133 (docs/SHIPS_AND_SKILLS.md §5.2-5.3, step S11): `effects` = what ONE LEVEL of a skill gives, one row of public.skill_effects each. scope company = the four live company effects public.player_skill_bonus reads (mirrors of skills.effect / pct_per_level; never gated, as before). scope ship = a per cent on a stat of world.ship_stats (hold, speed, handling, durability, armour, attack, accuracy, reach, sighting), optionally only on hulls of one role / tech. scope fitting = deck (+% of the Deck budget) or high_hands (-% of the Hands a High fitting needs), read by world.ship_budget. scope house = officer_bonus (+% on officers' bonuses inside public.fleet_officer_bonus, under the cap); K2 (0154) reads standing_routes (+1 route per level, public.standing_route_max_for), crew_wage (public.fleet_wage), crew_hire (public.crew_hire_cost), captain_wage (public.captain_wage), yard_labour (public.yard_labour), storm_damage (voyage.storm_hull_lost) and calm_delay (voyage.day_delay_for), the last two at the voyage's departure; profit_tax and influence wait for K2b, captain_xp and homesick for K6. A HULL skill's effects are not listed here: they are its line's two traits (data/ship-lines.json `traits`, `hull` = durability) on that line's hulls of that size (Capital Hulls: sizes 5 and 6, the flagship reads Capital Hulls). ship / fitting / house effects bite only while the knob skills_bite is true (shipped false). Given no effect yet, said plainly: the six specialisations (their T2 modules arrive with S15), Fleet Command, Refitting, Augmentation.
_requirements: 0133: `requirements` = what a hull (BUILD, cmd.do_build) or an item (FIT, public.mount_fitting) needs of the company: {kind: hull | item, code, skill, level}. Read by ONE rule, public.requirements_unmet (refusal E_NEEDS_SKILL; the build yard and the workshop serve the same sentence), only while skills_bite is true. EMPTY in S11: the three live hulls and the twelve G1 items need nothing (docs/SHIPS_AND_SKILLS.md §4.4, §6.2); S12 adds the new hulls' rows.
